source: docs/SEO/harvests/nl.json (1,384 unique google.nl autocomplete queries, 254 seeds, harvested 2026-07-06) + 12 live SERP samples (WebSearch, 2026-07-06). Research SoT: docs/SEO/demand-map-nl.md

titlePattern.singleAxisType: "<Demand-term> – gratis werkbladen printen (PDF)" — the harvest shows the same qualifiers dominate every Dutch worksheet query: printen/uitprinten, gratis, pdf, and the grade/age word (kleuters, groep 3). Demand-noun leads; qualifiers trail after an en-dash. ≤51 chars ideal before the " · LessonCraftStudio" suffix, 65 hard max.
titlePattern.singleAxisTheme: "Werkbladen <thema> – gratis printen (PDF)" — theme queries formulate as '<thema> werkbladen' or 'werkbladen <thema>' (minipret.nl owns the 'werkbladen <thema>' pattern); keep the theme hub broad (no grade) so it does not collide with the theme+grade deck landings.
titlePattern.singleAxisLevel: "Werkbladen <niveau> – gratis printen (PDF)" — level hubs own the bare grade head ('gratis werkbladen kleuters/groep 3'). Subject×grade hubs own '<vak> werkbladen groep N'; level topic pages stay subject-free.
titlePattern.intersection: "<Demand-term> groep 3/4 – werkbladen printen" (grade-trailing, the exact Dutch word order the harvest shows: 'woordzoeker groep 3', 'klokkijken groep 4', 'keersommen groep 4'). Grades lowercase mid-string. No theme — theme+type+grade belongs to deck landings.
titlePattern.notes: Every title unique across this file. 'online' is honest (decks play in the browser) but reserved for meta/body — the online-exercise hubs own the 'online oefenen' query class. Grades lowercase ('groep 3', 'kleuters', 'peuters'); de/het correct in prose. The 5 seasonal themes (christmas/easter/winter/spring/summer) are OWNED BY THE SEASONAL HUBS and are deliberately absent from singleAxis. NL market rivals: minipret.nl (dominant on themes+grades+woordzoekers), jufmaike/juf-milou/jufsanne (teacher blogs), printwerkblad.nl, mamaliefde.nl, kleuters-oefenen.nl, klokblaadjes.nl/klokrekenen.nl (klok generators), sommenprinter.nl/sommenmaker.nl (math generators), zwijsen.nl, squla.nl.
